findings.highlight: the pond was once home to a dragon.
findings.evidenceJa: 裏の池には竜が棲むという
findings.governingReading: 竜が棲むという reports the local tradition in the present.
findings.explanation: A reported resident dragon becomes a former resident.

findings.highlight: We exit the corridor and head for the back of the temple.
findings.evidenceJa: 廊下に出て寺の裏側に向かう
findings.governingReading: 廊下に出て identifies the corridor as the destination on the way to the rear temple.
findings.explanation: Going out into the corridor becomes exiting the corridor.

findings.highlight: Assassin prefers to kill Masters first, rather than duel other Servants!
findings.evidenceJa: 一騎打ちで望まなければ、先にマスターを叩かれてしまう
findings.governingReading: Saber says that unless she faces Assassin one-on-one, the Master will be attacked first.
findings.explanation: Saber's condition—face Assassin alone or expose the Master to the first attack—becomes a statement of Assassin's preference. Her protective purpose remains clear from the door and surrounding warnings.

findings.highlight: Saber's footsteps are faint but firm.
findings.governingReading: 足音は高く describes their high/loud sound, as Shirou hears her recede.
findings.explanation: Loud footsteps become faint but firm footsteps.

findings.highlight: a kyousaku stick that's handy enough to be a weapon
findings.governingReading: 木刀ほどの警策 gives the physical scale of the weapon he immediately Strengthens.
findings.explanation: A stick about the size of a wooden sword loses its size comparison.
